write.prompt: Many students arrive late at school because of traffic jams near the school gates at rush hour. What causes this problem, and what can schools and local authorities do to solve it?
write.taskVi: essay 4 đoạn, 200–250 từ: mở bài – nguyên nhân – giải pháp khớp nguyên nhân – kết bài. Mức cơ bản viết từng đoạn có khung; mức mở rộng viết liền.
mustUse: một câu với unless hoặc provided that
write.modelAfterSubmit:
Every morning, the roads around many city schools are blocked by motorbikes, cars and buses. As a result, a large number of students arrive late and stressed. This essay will explain the main causes of this problem and suggest what schools and local authorities could do about it.

The main cause is that thousands of families travel to the same place at exactly the same time. Since most schools start at seven o'clock, parents on motorbikes and in cars all arrive within a few minutes, and many stop at the gate to drop off their children. Buses cannot help much, because they are stuck in the same traffic. In addition, parked motorbikes and food stalls often cover the pavements, so students on foot have to walk on the road.

These problems can be reduced. If schools started classes at different times for different grades, the morning rush would be spread over half an hour. Local authorities could also create a short bus lane near large schools. Provided that it is kept clear, the bus would become a faster choice than a private vehicle. Unless the pavements are cleared, however, walking will remain unsafe.

In conclusion, traffic jams outside schools are mainly caused by everyone arriving at once and by too little space for buses and pedestrians. Should schools and the city work together on start times, bus lanes and pavements, students will be able to reach school safely and on time.
